meta.title: Developer apps — TUF
meta.description: Register OAuth apps for mods and extensions

title: Developer Portal
subtitle: Create public OAuth clients for mods, extensions, and tools. Confidential clients are coming soon.
createLede: Register a public client. You can upload an icon after the app is created.
emptyBody: Create an app to get a client ID and start Sign in with TUF.
empty: No apps yet. Create one to get a client ID.
deleteConfirm: Delete this app? Existing authorizations will stop working after grants expire or are revoked.
name: App name
redirectHint: Exact match required. https, custom schemes, extension URLs, and http://127.0.0.1 loopback are allowed.
redirectRequired: Add at least one redirect URI

redirectErrors.scheme: This URI scheme is not allowed
redirectErrors.httpLoopback: http is only allowed for 127.0.0.1 or localhost
redirectErrors.duplicate: That redirect URI is already added
redirectErrors.max: Maximum number of redirect URIs reached

scopesPublicOnly: Currently only public information can be requested. Contact the developer <discord>here</discord> if you need to expand this toolkit.
singleGrantHelp: Each new authorize for this app revokes other installs for the same user.
acceptTos: I agree not to use this app for phishing, abuse, or illegal activity, and to respect user privacy.
frozen: This app is frozen by staff and cannot be edited.
dangerBody: This permanently removes the client. Users with existing grants keep tokens until they expire or are revoked.
